description: Import an image attached in ChatGPT into the Pool Pro Florida CMS media library. ChatGPT supplies a temporary download URL and file ID through its native file parameter handoff. The server downloads the image directly, validates it, strips embedded metadata by re-encoding to WebP, stores it outside Git, and returns a stable /media/... URL. This tool does not modify any page.

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the image.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by ChatGPT for the attached file.

file_id.description: ChatGPT file identifier for the attached file.

file_name.description: Optional original filename supplied by ChatGPT.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type supplied by ChatGPT.

filename.description: Optional override filename. If omitted, the filename supplied by ChatGPT is used.

source.description: Whether the image came from image generation or a user upload.

tags.description: Optional media tags such as hero, riverview, or generated.

name: upload_media
title: Upload image to Pool Pro Florida media library
